description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractUploader' within the AWS SDK, responsible for managing multipart upload operations such as creating data parts, handling stream sources, and generating upload commands for large files.

classes.name: AbstractUploader
classes.description: An abstract class managing multipart uploads, providing methods for handling data sources, creating upload parts, and generating commands for uploading parts to AWS.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the uploader with a client, data source, and configuration, setting up the source stream.

methods.name: limitPartStream
methods.description: Creates a limited stream for an upload part, enforcing size restrictions based on part size.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Generates upload commands for each data part, handling seekable sources and resumable uploads.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Abstract method to generate parameters for an upload part based on source data.

methods.name: isEof
methods.description: Checks whether the source stream has reached EOF.

methods.name: determineSource
methods.description: Converts the input source into a readable stream, supporting file paths and stream resources.

methods.name: getNumberOfParts
methods.description: Calculates the total number of parts based on the source size and part size.
